tha-ap129:1.1: Phaladāyaka.] Ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedāna-pāragū / Himavantass' avidūre vasāmi assame ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap129:2.1: Aggihuttañ ca me atthi puṇḍarīka-phalāni ca / puṭake nikkhipitvāna dumagge laggitaṃ mayā. // //
tha-ap129:3.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / mam uddharitukāmo so bhikkhanto mam upāgami. // //
tha-ap129:4.1: Pasannacitto sumano phalaṃ Buddhass' adās' ahaṃ / vittisañjanano mayhaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhāvaho. // //
tha-ap129:5.1: Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sambuddho āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / antalikkhe ṭhito satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap129:6.1: ‘Iminā phaladānena cetanā paṇidhīhi ca / kappānaṃ satasahassaṃ duggatiṃ nūpagacchati.' // //
tha-ap129:7.1: Ten' eva sukkamūlena anubhotvāna sampadā / patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ. // //
tha-ap129:8.1: Ito sattakappasate rājā āsi Sumaṅgalo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap129:10.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Phaladāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
